experiment: Task B two-class fine-tuning of RoBERTa-large-MNLI on FEVER SUPPORTS/REFUTES with gold evidence
note: Sized for an 8 GB GPU: gradient checkpointing is required (without it peak memory exceeds the card). The three-way MNLI head is kept; NEUTRAL is never a training target.
premise: evidence sentences of the selected gold group, in stored order, joined by one space
primary_protocol: per_sentence: unchanged nli_predictor (each evidence sentence scored, project aggregation rule) + fever_binary_proxy; identical to the zero-shot baseline
secondary_protocol: joined: one (joined evidence, claim) pair per claim, argmax of three classes, same label mapping and binary proxy
selection_metric: validation macro-F1 under the primary protocol; fine-tuned checkpoints only; ties keep the earlier step
